usage_note: TRAP: Haitian Creole for breakfast is 'manje maten' (lit. morning food), NOT the French 'petit-déjeuner'. Do not default to French.
TRAP: bread is 'pen' in Kreyol, NOT French 'pain'. A common French-default failure.
Pancake/crepe as 'krep' in Kreyol orthography (phonetic), vs French crêpe. Kreyol spells by sound.
Water is 'dlo'. Illustrates Kreyol is its own language, not accented French.
Coffee 'kafe' (phonetic), vs French café. Morning ritual term.
Good 'bon' — one of the few tokens that overlaps French spelling; note the overlap is coincidental, treat Kreyol as primary.
Protein rendered phonetically 'pwoteyin' in Kreyol vs French protéine.
Child 'timoun' (ti moun = little person). Family-audience register.
'Real quick' / fast — convenience register for on-the-go framing.
Flour 'farin' (no final e), vs French farine. Product-ingredient term.
